info.name: Quidax Wallets API
info.description:
Create and manage crypto and fiat wallets for your users, move funds in and out, and trade.

Set `secretKey` in collection variables. This key reaches every sub-account including withdrawals — keep it server-side.

Docs: https://docs.quidax.com/api-reference/wallets/introduction
